name: [STUDLANDS COLLAB] CRAB ROYALE
desc:
Crabsolute Cinema.

The ultimate lifeform. Crabs. 
Fast paced action PVP shooter where you play as a crab and fight other crabs to the death for glory and fame! Become the best crab to ever crab!

CODES IN THE COMMUNITY SERVER!!

(Progress doesn't save in private servers)

[If you have epilepsy play with caution]
